label: Change Request Impact Assessor
description: Evaluates project change requests for scope, schedule, budget, resource, and risk impact. Produces structured change request documentation with approval recommendation.

claudeKnowledge.description: Change control management, project impact assessment, PRINCE2 change management, scope creep analysis

guidedInputs.label: Change request description
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the proposed change clearly and specifically. What is being added, removed, or modified?
e.g. Client has requested addition of a real-time transaction monitoring dashboard to the deliverables of the AMLR implementation. Original scope included batch reporting only. The dashboard would require real-time data feeds from 4 core banking systems.

guidedInputs.label: Change requestor
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Client: CFO, Nordea AB — 14 February 2025

guidedInputs.label: Business justification
guidedInputs.placeholder: Why is this change being requested? What business need or problem does it address?

guidedInputs.label: Current project baseline (affected areas)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the relevant aspects of the current approved project baseline:
- Scope: what is currently in scope
- Schedule: current timeline and key milestones
- Budget: total budget and current spend/forecast
- Resources: current team size and allocation

guidedInputs.label: Preliminary team assessment (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Any initial estimates or assessments from the delivery team regarding the change impact.

guidedInputs.label: Key constraints
guidedInputs.placeholder: Any fixed constraints that the change must respect (e.g. fixed go-live date, budget cap, contractual obligations, regulatory deadline).
